questions.q: Vasu gave 12000 of the amount what he had to Nithi. Nithi gave 3/5th of what he received from Vasu to Sara. Sara after paying Rs. 500 to the taxi driver out of the amount she get from Nithi, Sara is now left with Rs. x+300. Find square root of x.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai TestRipper, yahan ek sequence me paise transfer ho rahe hain aur last ka bacha hua part $x+300$ diya hai. Option dekh, saare perfect squares hain. Seedha reverse chal aur mental maths se minus karta jaa.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Ulta chalte hain (Reverse calculation) without wasting ink.

Mathematically :-
$$12000 \times \frac{3}{5} = 7200 \\\\ 7200 - 500 = 6700 \\\\ x + 300 = 6700 \\\\ x = 6400 \\\\ \sqrt{x} = 80$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Step by step variables assign karke values nikalte hain.

Mathematically :-
$$Amount_{Nithi} = 12000 \\\\ Amount_{Sara} = 12000 \times \frac{3}{5} = 7200 \\\\ Balance_{Sara} = 7200 - 500 = 6700 \\\\ x + 300 = 6700 \Rightarrow x = 6400 \\\\ \sqrt{x} = 80$$

Exam Takeaway: Jab value transfer ho rahi ho step-by-step, toh chain sequence follow karke end result nikalna sabse easy hota hai. Pen kam chalao.

Reverse Tracing TrickBase $\times$ Fraction 1 $-$ Expense $=$ End Amount

questions.q: In a speed test a student got 30% marks and failed by 25 marks. In the same speed test another student got 40% marks and secured 25% marks more than the essential minimum marks. Then max. marks set for speed test?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, dono situations me Passing Marks (PM) humesha same hi honge. Dono data points ko utha ke bas Passing Marks ke reference pe le ja kar equate kar dena hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Passing marks ko apna common anchor bana aur dono conditions ko takra de!

Mathematically :-
$$PM_1 = 30\% + 25$$
$$1.25 \times PM_2 = 40\% \implies PM_2 = 32\%$$
$$30\% + 25 = 32\% \implies 2\% = 25$$
$$100\% = 25 \times 50 = 1250$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic variable ($M$) leke basic algebra laga ke equation solve kar.

Mathematically :-
$$0.4M = 1.25(0.3M + 25)$$
$$0.4M = 0.375M + 31.25 \implies 0.025M = 31.25 \implies M = 1250$$

Exam Takeaway: Pass/Fail marks wale questions me ek single reference equation banakar percent ko marks se equate kar liya kar.

List IList II
Find common anchor$PM_1 = PM_2$

questions.q: If 12.5% of p is equal to 50% of q, what is the ratio p: q? (CGL TIER I - 19/09/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $12.5\%$ is $\frac{1}{8}$ aur $50\%$ is $\frac{1}{2}$. Dono ko aamne-saamne rakh aur ratio sidha tere samne aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Fractions me convert kar aur shift kar. Mathematically :-

$\frac{1}{8}p = \frac{1}{2}q$

$\frac{p}{q} = \frac{8}{2} = \frac{4}{1}$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Percentages ko solve kar equation banakar. Mathematically :-

$\frac{12.5}{100} \times p = \frac{50}{100} \times q$

$12.5p = 50q$

$\frac{p}{q} = \frac{50}{12.5} = \frac{4}{1}$

Exam Takeaway: Fraction conversions hamesha secondary steps ko eliminate kar dete hain.

List IList II
Base Conversion$12.5\% = \frac{1}{8}$

questions.q: Annually income of Arun is 6.24 lakh, he spend $38\frac{6}{13}\%$ of monthly income on Food and Rent, $12.5\%$ of remaining on Gym, $14\frac{2}{7}\%$ of remaining on clothing and $75\%$ of remaining invested in mutual fund. if he kept remaining amount after all expense as cash with him then find how much cash Arun have after one year?
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: Successive Change (Chain Reaction)]

Pen-Free Observation: Har jagah 'remaining' use hua hai, matlab successive multiplier lagega. Fractions yaad hain toh ek line ka question hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
$38\frac{6}{13}\% = \frac{5}{13} \Rightarrow \text{Bacha } \frac{8}{13}$.
$12.5\% = \frac{1}{8} \Rightarrow \text{Bacha } \frac{7}{8}$.
$14\frac{2}{7}\% = \frac{1}{7} \Rightarrow \text{Bacha } \frac{6}{7}$.
$75\% = \frac{3}{4} \Rightarrow \text{Bacha } \frac{1}{4}$.
Multiply karke total remaining fraction nikal: $\frac{8}{13} \times \frac{7}{8} \times \frac{6}{7} \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{6}{52} = \frac{3}{26}$.
Total income $6,24,000$ hai. Cash $= 624000 \times \frac{3}{26} = 24000 \times 3 = 72000 \text{ Rs}$.

Takeaway: Jab initial value aur final value ki baat ho toh chain reaction best tool hai.

questions.q: Out of total income a person's expenditure on food, cloth and other items are in the ratio of 3: 4: 3 respectively. If his expenditure is increased by 12% on food and 15% on cloth and decreased by 8% on other items. What percent should his income be increased so that no effect is recorded on the consumption of food, cloth and other items ?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ratios di hain 3:4:3. Inko sidha 300, 400 aur 300 maan le. Income base 1000 banega. Bas change nikal aur 1000 pe percentage fenk.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Zeroes assum kar aur base 1000 pe deviation nikal. Mathematically :-

$+ (300 \times 12\%) = +36$

$+ (400 \times 15\%) = +60$

$- (300 \times 8\%) = -24$

$\text{Net} = 36 + 60 - 24 = +72$

$\text{Inc } \% = \frac{72}{1000} \times 100 = 7.2\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Weighted average approach laga fraction me. Mathematically :-

$\text{Total parts} = 3+4+3 = 10$

$\text{Change} = \frac{(3 \times 12) + (4 \times 15) + (3 \times -8)}{10}$

$\text{Change} = \frac{36 + 60 - 24}{10} = \frac{72}{10} = 7.2\%$

Exam Takeaway: Jaha split ratio di ho waha zeros chipka ke life aasan kiya kar ya direct weighted average laga, fraction apne aap set hoga.

List IList II
Weighted Deviation$\frac{\sum (R_i \times \%_i)}{\sum R_i}$

questions.q:
Quantity I: if the length of a rectangle is increased by $40\%$ while the breadth of the rectangle is decreased by $20\%$ then find percentage change in area of the rectangle?
Quantity II: if the side of a triangle is increased by $60\%$ while the height of a triangle is decreased by $40\%$ then find the percentage change in area of the triangle?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Area ka formula humesha do variables ka product hota hai (jaise $L \times B$ ya $1/2 \times B \times H$). Constant ($1/2$) se percentage change ko fark nahi padta. Dono jagah AB rule ($a+b+ab/100$) lagana hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Q I ke liye: $+40$ aur $-20$. Formula: $40 - 20 - \frac{40 \times 20}{100} = 20 - 8 = +12\%$. Q II ke liye: $+60$ aur $-40$. Formula: $60 - 40 - \frac{60 \times 40}{100} = 20 - 24 = -4\%$. Saaf dikh raha hai ki $+12\%$ bada hai $-4\%$ se, yani Quantity I > Quantity II. Bina tension direct compare kar de! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractions se kar le. Q I: $L$ badha $\frac{2}{5}$ se ($\to 7/5$), $B$ ghata $\frac{1}{5}$ se ($\to 4/5$). Area $= \frac{7}{5} \times \frac{4}{5} = \frac{28}{25}$. Change = $+3/25 = +12\%$. Q II: Base badha $\frac{3}{5}$ se ($\to 8/5$), Height ghati $\frac{2}{5}$ se ($\to 3/5$). Area $= \frac{8}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} = \frac{24}{25}$. Change = $-1/25 = -4\%$. Dono tarike fit hain. Exam Takeaway: Product based formulas me sidha successive wala funda chipkao. Constant numbers percentage change me aukaat nahi rakhte!
QuantityNet Change
1. Rectangle$+12\%$
2. Triangle$-4\%$

questions.q: If the volume of a cube increases by $119.7\%$, what is the percentage change in its total surface area?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Volume 3D ($x^3$) me chalta hai aur Area 2D ($x^2$) me. Tujhe cube root lekar side pe aana hai fir square karke area nikalna hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Volume $100$ se badh kar $219.7$ ho gaya. Zero shift kar de toh ratio banega $1000 : 2197$. Ye kiske cube hain? $10^3$ aur $13^3$. Yani cube ki side 10 se 13 ho gayi. Hamein 2D (Surface Area) chahiye, toh side ka square kar de: $10^2 : 13^2 = 100 : 169$. $100$ se $169$ ho jana matlab direct $69\%$ ki vridhi. Ye cubes 15 tak raate hone chahiye bhai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Side $= a$. Naya volume $= 2.197 a^3$. Nayi side $= \sqrt[3]{2.197} a = 1.3 a$. Purana Surface Area $= 6a^2$. Naya Surface Area $= 6(1.3a)^2 = 6 \times 1.69 a^2$. Multiplier $1.69$ aagaya, jiska matlab $+69\%$ hota hai. Exam Takeaway: $10\%$, $20\%$, $30\%$ ke 3 saal ke CI / Volume multipliers dimag me chap le. Jaise hi 219.7 dikha, $30\%$ (1.3) yaad aana chahiye.
DimensionMultiplier
1. Volume (3D)2.197 ($13^3 / 10^3$)
2. Side (1D)1.3 ($13 / 10$)
3. Area (2D)1.69 ($+69\%$)

questions.q: Two candidates contested an election. 10% of people on the voting list did not vote and 60 votes recorded were rejected as illegal. The majority of successful candidate was 308 and it was found that he had been supported by 47% of the whole number of the voter's list. What were the total votes.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, winner ko total ka 47% mila hai. Loser ko bache hue valid votes milenge. Ye jo 60 invalid votes hain, ye directly loser ke khate se katenge jisse winner ka margin badh jayega.



Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total votes ko 100x maan le. Winner le gaya 47x. Toh baaki bacha 43x. Agar sab sahi hota toh margin 4x hota. Par 60 votes invalid the, isiliye margin $308 - 60 = 248$ reh gaya. Seedha $4\% = 248 \implies 1\% = 62$. Toh total $100\% = 6200$. 10 second ka khel hai!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic se dekhe toh Total = $x$. Valid $= 0.9x - 60$. Winner $= 0.47x$. Loser ko mila $(0.9x - 60) - 0.47x = 0.43x - 60$. Ab equation bana: $0.47x - (0.43x - 60) = 308 \implies 0.04x = 248$.

Exam Takeaway: CGL me jab bhi absolute invalid votes diye hon, unhe margin me se minus karke percentage ke barabar rakh de.

ConceptShortcut
Election MarginWinner % - Loser % = Margin. Always base % on total list.

questions.q: In an election for college president held in a college, the voting percentage was 83.33%. The winner got 33.33% of the polled votes, while the runner-up got 22.22% of the polled votes. If there were 216108 voters in the university, by how many votes did the winner win the election?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sab kuch standard fractions hai. Base Total hai. Polled nikalo $5/6$ karke, fir polled ka win gap direct minus karke nikalo. Beech me koi step solve mat karna warna time kharab hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Sab fraction me likh kar margin ko final equation se ek jhatke me udhao.

Mathematically :-
$$Total = 216108 \\\\ Polled = 216108 \times \frac{5}{6} = 180090 \\\\ Margin = (\frac{1}{3} - \frac{2}{9}) \ of \ Polled \\\\ Margin = (\frac{3}{9} - \frac{2}{9}) = \frac{1}{9} \\\\ Win \ Votes = 180090 \times \frac{1}{9} = 20010$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Polled nikal kar, fir Winner, fir Loser ke votes alag se nikalna.

Mathematically :-
$$Polled = 216108 \times \frac{5}{6} = 180090 \\\\ Winner = 180090 \times \frac{1}{3} = 60030 \\\\ Loser = 180090 \times \frac{2}{9} = 40020 \\\\ Difference = 60030 - 40020 = 20010$$

Exam Takeaway: Election questions me 'Polled' aur 'Total' ka farak jaan lena zaroori hai. Har stage pe multiply karne se bacho, final cut ek sath karo.

List IList II
Fraction Memory$83.33\% = 5/6$, $22.22\% = 2/9$

questions.q: If decreasing 120 by x% gives the same result as increasing 40 by x% then x% of 720 is what percentage more than (x+15)% of 200? (Round off to the nearest integer)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, seedhi si baat hai $120$ ko ghata rahe ho aur $40$ ko badha rahe ho aur dono same level pe aa rahe hain. Linear equation banegi jahan se $x$ chutki me nikal aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle relation se $x$ ko paka aur direct second statement me put karke percentage gap nikal!

Mathematically :-
$$120\left(1 - \frac{x}{100}\right) = 40\left(1 + \frac{x}{100}\right) \implies 3(100 - x) = 100 + x$$
$$300 - 3x = 100 + x \implies 4x = 200 \implies x = 50$$
$$\text{P1} = 50\% \times 720 = 360$$
$$\text{P2} = 65\% \times 200 = 130$$
$$\text{Req } \% = \frac{360 - 130}{130} \times 100 = \frac{230}{130} \times 100 \approx 176.9\% \approx 177\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equation ko fraction banake variables solve karne ka basic step.

Mathematically :-
$$120(1 - x) = 40(1 + x) \dots$$

Exam Takeaway: SSC Mains ke exams me aisi 2-step problems bahut aati hain. Target hamesha step 1 se variable nikal ke jaldi step 2 me daalna hota hai bina ruke.

List IList II
Percentage Gap$\frac{\text{Diff}}{\text{Base}} \times 100$

questions.q: A stock portfolio consists of four stocks. Stock A represents 10% of the portfolio and has a return of 4%. Stock B represents 20% of the portfolio and has a return of 8%. Stock C represents 30% of the portfolio and has a return of 3%. Stock D represents the remaining 40% of the portfolio and has a <u>negative-return</u> of 6%. What is the average return of the portfolio?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan portfolio ke alag alag hisso ko unke returns se seedha multiply karna hai. Positive wale add honge aur jisme nuksan (negative) hai wo subtract hoga. Aur total base humesha $100\%$ ka weight rahega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Weights aur returns ki values ko direct multiply karke jodd de aur seedha $100$ se divide maar!

Mathematically :-
$$10(4) + 20(8) + 30(3) + 40(-6) = 40 + 160 + 90 - 240 = 50$$
$$\text{Avg Return} = \frac{50}{100} = 0.5\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Standard weighted average ka proper formula laga ke calculation kar.

Mathematically :-
$$\frac{w_1r_1 + w_2r_2 + w_3r_3 + w_4r_4}{w_1+w_2+w_3+w_4} = \frac{40+160+90-240}{100} = 0.5\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Weighted average nikalte waqt negative values pe dhyan se nazar rakhna, wahan silly mistake ke chances bahut zyada hote hain.

List IList II
Weighted Sum$\frac{\Sigma (Weight \times Return)}{\Sigma Weight}$

questions.q: Every day a fruit seller sells 66.67% of the fruits he has and 50% of the fruits rot overnight. If a total of 688 fruits rot in three nights, then how many fruits did he start with on the first day.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fraction ka jaal hai. $2/3$ sell hue, bache $1/3$. Unka $50\% (1/2)$ sad gaye. Har din $1/6$ sadenge. Options me aakhri digits alag hain. Unit digit trick laga kar seedha attack hoga bina heavy calc ke.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Denominators ka LCM initial value assume karo aur tree method banao, unit digit verify karo.

Mathematically :-
$$Total = 6 \times 6 \times 6 = 216 \\\\ Rot_{Day1} = 216 \times \frac{1}{6} = 36 \\\\ Rot_{Day2} = 36 \times \frac{1}{6} = 6 \\\\ Rot_{Day3} = 6 \times \frac{1}{6} = 1 \\\\ Total \ Rot = 36 + 6 + 1 = 43 \\\\ 43 \ units = 688 \Rightarrow 1 \ unit = 16 \\\\ Total = 216 \times 16 = 3456$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable x rakh kar fraction addition karo.

Mathematically :-
$$Total = x \\\\ Rot = x \times \frac{1}{6} + (x \times \frac{1}{6}) \times \frac{1}{6} + ((x \times \frac{1}{6}) \times \frac{1}{6}) \times \frac{1}{6} = 688 \\\\ x(\frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{36} + \frac{1}{216}) = 688 \\\\ x(\frac{43}{216}) = 688 \Rightarrow x = 3456$$

Exam Takeaway: Tree method lagana aur fractional denominators ka LCM initial value assume karna is best for remaining items questions.

List IList II
Unit Digit Check$216 \times 16 \Rightarrow 6 \times 6 = 36$, Ends with $6$.

questions.q: A fraction is reduced such that when it is squared and then its numerator is increased by $20\%$ and denominator is reduced by $25\%$, it results in $\frac{6}{5}$ of the original fraction. The product of the numerator and denominator is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fraction change ko seedha multiplier me likh aur equation ko direct kaat, variable $F$ apne aap bahar aayegi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Direct decimal fraction. Mathematically :-
$$F^2 \times \frac{1.20}{0.75} = \frac{6}{5} F$$
$$F = \frac{6}{5} \times \frac{75}{120} = \frac{3}{4}$$
$$N \times D = 3 \times 4 = 12$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional split method. Mathematically :-
$$F^2 \times \frac{\frac{6}{5}}{\frac{3}{4}} = \frac{6}{5} F$$
$$F^2 \times \frac{24}{15} = \frac{6}{5} F$$
$$F = \frac{6}{5} \times \frac{15}{24} = \frac{3}{4}$$
$$N \times D = 12$$

Exam Takeaway: Decimal multipliers use kar, values turant fraction form me cancel out hogi.

List IList II
Multiplier Hack$1.20 / 0.75 = 120 / 75$ instantly yields $8 / 5$ factor.

questions.q: A scholarship fund of Rs. 1200 is to be distributed between two students, A and B, in a ratio 5:3. However, after allocating 200 to administrative charges, the remaining amount is first increased by 10% as a bonus before the final division. What amount will student A receive? (PHASE XIII(HS) - 24/07/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, amount me se directly deduction aur bonus calculate karke final pool alag kar. Us pool ka $\frac{5}{8}$ seedha A ka hissa banega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Final pool ko direct fraction multiplier ke sath jod de. Mathematically :-

$\text{Pool} = (1200 - 200) \times 1.10 = 1100$

$A_{share} = 1100 \times \frac{5}{8}$

$A_{share} = 1100 \times 0.625 = 687.5$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Har step alag solve kar aur unit value nikal kar multiply kar. Mathematically :-

$\text{Rem} = 1200 - 200 = 1000$

$\text{Final} = 1000 + 10\% = 1100$

$\text{Total parts} = 5+3 = 8 \Rightarrow 8 \text{ parts } = 1100$

$1 \text{ part } = 137.5$

$A = 5 \times 137.5 = 687.5$

Exam Takeaway: Ratio ke final value ko parts me todne se behtar seedha multiplier se fraction multiply kar diya kar.

List IList II
Proportional Shift$A = \text{Total} \times \frac{A_{ratio}}{\sum \text{Ratios}}$

questions.q: Rate of tax increase by 18%, if net income reduced by 2%. Find initial rate of tax.
questions.s:
Tool Triggered: 1. CPR

The "Pen-Free" Observation First:
Dekh bhai, jab tax badhta hai toh net income usi absolute value se girti hai. Seedha funda: Tax ka $18\%$ = Net Income ka $2\%$. Ratio 1:9. Total income 10 units. Tax rate $1/10 = 10\%$.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Direct equivalence formula.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Tax} \times 18\% = \text{Net Income} \times 2\% \\ \frac{\text{Tax}}{\text{Net Income}} = \frac{2}{18} = \frac{1}{9} \\ \text{Total Income} = 1 + 9 = 10 \text{ units} \\ \text{Tax Rate} = \frac{1}{10} \times 100 = 10\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder):
Basic definitions ko equate karna.

Mathematically :-
$$ \text{Total Income} = \text{Net Income} + \text{Tax} \\ \Delta \text{Tax} + \Delta \text{Net Income} = 0 \text{ (Total Income is constant)} \\ \Delta \text{Tax} = - \Delta \text{Net Income} \\ T \times \frac{18}{100} = NI \times \frac{2}{100} \\ 18 T = 2 NI \implies NI = 9 T \\ \text{Total Income} = 9 T + T = 10 T \\ \text{Rate} = \frac{T}{10 T} \times 100 = 10\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Ye pattern SSC ka damad hai. Hamesha Tax / (Tax + Net Income) laga aur age badh!

questions.q: The present population of a village is 45,840. If the number of males increases by $25\%$ and that of females increases by $15\%$, then the population will become 55,284. What is the difference between the initial number of males and females in the village?
questions.s:
The "Pen-Free" Observation First:

Dekh bhai, isme Mixture Alligation ya phir Base Shifting lagate hain. Maan le pura gaon hi $15\%$ se badh gaya hota. Total kitna badhta? Jo extra badha hai woh sirf Males ke bache hue $10\%$ ka kamaal hai.

Method 1 (Base Shifting Concept):

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Actual Increase} = 55284 - 45840 = 9444 \\ \text{Base } 15\% \text{ Increase} = 45840 \times 15\% = 6876 \\ \text{Extra Increase} = 9444 - 6876 = 2568 \\ 10\% \text{ of } M = 2568 \implies M = 25680 \\ F = 45840 - 25680 = 20160 \\ M - F = 25680 - 20160 = 5520 $$

Exam Takeaway: Base Shifting wali trick CDS aur CGL dono ke time consuming mixture problems ko crush karti hai.

questions.q: The price of an article decreased by 8% every year. If the difference between the price at the end of the third and fourth year is 69, then 40% of the price at the end of the second year is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: 3rd aur 4th year ke beech ka difference purely 3rd year ki value ka 8% hi toh hoga! Piche calculate karna hai (reverse successive). Digital sum ya multiples check kar sakte ho, par calculation aasan hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $8\% \text{ of } P_3 = 69 \implies P_3 = \frac{6900}{8}$. Ab $P_3$ aaya kaise? $P_2$ me 8% ghata ke, yaani $P_2 \times 0.92 = P_3$. Toh $P_2 = \frac{6900}{8 \times 0.92}$. Humein $40\%$ (yaani 0.4) of $P_2$ chahiye: $0.4 \times \frac{6900}{8 \times 0.92} = 375$. Calculation ko end tak hold kar!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let starting price be P. $P_3 = P \times (0.92)^3$. Difference $P_3 - P_4 = P_3 - P_3(0.92) = P_3(0.08) = 69$. Step by step nikalne me time waste hota hai, seedha reverse shift lagao.

Best Exam Approach: Method 1, combined with intermediate step skipping.

questions.q: In a biological study of 2023, a mutant virus colony had a total population of 8,57,432, and exactly 14.1% of them were highly active. In 2024, the total population surged to 11,48,958 and the active percentage rate bumped to 17.2%. What is the approximate percentage change in the absolute number of highly active viruses?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, TCS exam mein aise gande numbers sirf tumhara time kharab karne ke liye deta hai. Active viruses = Population $\times$ Rate ($A \times B = K$). Jab dono multiplier change hote hain, toh net effect successive formula se nikalta hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Options mein gap acha hai, toh hum exact values ko goli maarenge aur sirf approximate percentage shifts nikalenge! Tick maar aur aage badh!

Mathematically :-
$$ \\Delta Pop \\approx \\frac{11.48 - 8.57}{8.57} \\times 100 \\approx 34\\% \\\\ \\Delta Rate \\approx \\frac{17.2 - 14.1}{14.1} \\times 100 \\approx 22\\% \\\\ Net \\ \\Delta = 34 + 22 + \\frac{34 \\times 22}{100} \\\\ = 56 + 7.48 = 63.48\\% \\approx 64\\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute numbers nikal kar subtract karke percentage generate kar. Boht calculation hai.

Mathematically :-
$$ Active_{2023} = 857432 \\times 0.141 = 120897.9 \\\\ Active_{2024} = 1148958 \\times 0.172 = 197620.7 \\\\ \\% \\Delta = \\frac{197620.7 - 120897.9}{120897.9} \\times 100 = 63.46\\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Data Interpretation (DI) aur Percentage ke gande sums jahan $A \times B = K$ lag raha ho, wahan exact calculation pap hai. Hamesha base aur shift ka approximate ratio nikal ke successive change lapaad diya kar.

List I (Variable)List II (Approximate Value)
A. Pop Increase Shift1. $34\%$
B. Rate Increase Shift2. $22\%$

questions.q: A’s salary is 120% of B’s salary and B spends 60% of his salary for house rent and education fees. If B’s savings is Rs. 1800 and A’s expenditure is 40% more than that of B, then what is the saving amount of A?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 5. Unitary Scaling

**Pen-Free Observation:**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, seedha B ki savings (absolute value) de rakhi hai aur saara percentage flow ek dusre se linked hai. Aise continuous sequence me variables ($x, y$) lene ki zarurat hi nahi hoti. Base $100$ pakdo aur seedha line se link karte hue A ki savings tak pahunch jao!

**Method 1 (Base $100$ / Exam Approach):**
Maan lo B ki Income = $100$ units.
Toh A ki Income = $120$ units.
B ka Expenditure = $60$ units, matlab B ki Savings = $40$ units.
A ka Expenditure = $40\%$ zyada hai B ke expenditure se = $60 + (60 \times \frac{40}{100}) = 84$ units.
A ki Savings = $120 - 84 = 36$ units.

Question ke hisaab se: B ki savings $40 \text{ units} \equiv 1800$
$1 \text{ unit} \equiv 45$
A ki savings = $36 \text{ units} = 36 \times 45 = 1620$.

**Method 2 (Ratio / Concept Builder):**
Salary ratio A:B = $120:100 = 6:5$.
B ka Exp : Savings = $60:40 = 3:2$.
Humein pata hai B ki Savings ($2 \text{ units}$) = $1800 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 900$.
Yahan se B ki Salary ($5 \text{ units}$) = $4500$, aur B ka Exp ($3 \text{ units}$) = $2700$.
Ratio se A ki Salary = $6 \times 900 = 5400$.
A ka Exp $40\%$ zyada hai B ke Exp ($2700$) se = $2700 \times 1.4 = 3780$.
A ki Savings = $5400 - 3780 = 1620$.


🏆 **Exam Takeaway: Kab Kya Lagana Hai? (The Thumb Rule)**
Dimag me yeh flowchart chhap le taaki exam me 2 second me decision le sake ki konsa method uthana hai:

Question Ka StructureKaunsa Tool Use Karein?Kyun?
1. Continuous Percentage Flow (e.g., A is $20\%$ more than B, B spends $40\%$ of his income, A's exp is $10\%$ more than B)Base $100$ / Absolute Unitary ScalingKyunki ek hi chain chal rahi hai. Variables introduce karne ki zarurat nahi hai. Ek value se dusri connect hoti jayegi.
2. Separate Ratios + Cross Relation (e.g., Income Ratio $3:2$, Exp Ratio $4:3$, and Income of A = Exp of B)Ratios ($x$ and $y$ variables)Kyunki data disconnected hai. Ratios ko balance karke ek common variable me lana sabse fast hota hai.
3. Direct Mapping available (Jaise is question me tha)Ratios / Direct UnitaryAgar kisi ratio ke part ki exact absolute value mil jaye, toh ratio method sabse tej bhagta hai.

questions.q: The number of peacocks in a bird sanctuary was P in the year 2000. The number decreased by $10\%$ in the next decade and increased by $50\%$ in the decade after that. If the difference between the number of peacocks in the years 2020 and 2000 is 5250, and it increased by $36\%$ in the next half decade, then what is the number of peacocks in the year 2025?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, pehle gira fir utha. Net successive change nikal, P ki value aayegi. Uske baad 2025 ki value aayegi jo 1.36 se multiply karke banegi, jiska DS 9 HOGA COZ +18/50 SO opt C&D elmnt and unit digit pakad lena hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Net effect = 0.9 x 1.5 = 1.35. Yani 35% bada. $35\% = 5250$ toh $100\% (P) = 15000$. 2020 me = $15000 \times 1.35 = 20250$. Naya 36% bada, $20250 \times 1.36$. Last digit zero ke baad 4 aayega, option B me 40 hai, seedha tick maar!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Net}_1 = 0.9 \times 1.5 = 1.35$
$\text{Diff} = 35\% = 5250 \implies 100\% = 15000$
$P_{2020} = 15000 \times 1.35 = 20250$
$P_{2025} = 20250 \times 1.36 = 27540$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): $P - P(0.9)(1.5)$ likh ke formula banayega, subtract karega toh bhi end me calculation unit digit se hi fast hogi.

Mathematically :-
$P(1.5)(0.9) - P = 5250$
$0.35P = 5250 \implies P = 15000$
$P_{2025} = 15000(1.35)(1.36) = 27540$

Exam Takeaway: Pure multiplication mat kar, Unit digit aur Digital Sum hamesha bachate hain successive problems me.

questions.q: The ratio of the monthly income of P to the monthly income of Q is 7:10, and P's saving is $21\frac{3}{7}\%$ more than Q's savings. Find the expenditure of P if the sum of the monthly income of P and Q is $85,000$, and the expenditure of Q is $22,000$.
questions.s:
[Core Tool Triggered: Unitary Scaling]

Pen-Free Observation: $7+10 = 17$ units $= 85000$. $1 \text{ unit} = 5000$. P ki income $35k$, Q ki $50k$. Q ki saving = Income - Exp = $50k - 22k = 28k$.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique):
Income $P = 35,000$, $Q = 50,000$.
Q ki saving $= 50,000 - 22,000 = 28,000$.
P ki saving Q se $21\frac{3}{7}\%$ zyada hai. Percentage ka fraction bana: $21\frac{3}{7}\% = \frac{150}{7}\% = \frac{150}{700} = \frac{3}{14}$.
P's saving $= 28,000 + (28,000 \times \frac{3}{14}) = 28,000 + 6,000 = 34,000$.
P ka exp $= \text{Income} - \text{Saving} = 35,000 - 34,000 = 1,000$.

Takeaway: Weird percentages ko hamesha fraction me tod lo, exam setter wahi values deta hai jo denominator se cut jayen (jaise $28000$ aur $14$).

questions.q: The income of Manju is Rs. 6000 and his income is increased by 25%, then decreased by x% and there after increased by (x – 10)%. Find the income of Manju after a rise of (x – 10)%, If the income of Manju after a decrease of x% is the same as his initial salary.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, steps me tod isko. 6k ka 25% jyada 7.5k hua. Wapas 6k aana hai toh kitna kam hua? 1.5k. 1.5k 7.5k ka kitna hai? Seedha $20\%$. Matlab $x=20$ nikal aya.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Value shift fraction se x nikal aur final me add karde.

Mathematically :-
$$6000 \times 1.25 = 7500 \\\\ Decrease = \frac{7500 - 6000}{7500} = \frac{1500}{7500} = \frac{1}{5} = 20\% \Rightarrow x = 20 \\\\ Final \ Rise = (20 - 10)\% = 10\% \\\\ Final \ Income = 6000 \times 1.10 = 6600$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Base equation banakar equation solve karo.

Mathematically :-
$$6000(1 + \frac{25}{100})(1 - \frac{x}{100}) = 6000 \\\\ 1.25 (1 - \frac{x}{100}) = 1 \\\\ 1 - \frac{x}{100} = \frac{4}{5} \Rightarrow x = 20 \\\\ New = 6000(1 + \frac{10}{100}) = 6600$$

Exam Takeaway: Language ko portions me decode karo, x ki value direct base shift karne se aati hai.

questions.q: The income of person X is $60 \%$ less than that of person Y, and the expenditure of X is equal to $60 \%$ of Y's expenditure. If X's income is equal to $70 \%$ of Y's expenditure, then what is the ratio of the savings of X and Y?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Cross-Product

Pen-Free Observation: Y ki expenditure ko aisi value maan jiska percentage aaram se nikle, jaise 400. Sab us par depend kar raha hai, bina $x$ liye directly saari values integer me aayengi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Kisi ek independent base ko 100 ka multiple maan kar saari values nikal lo.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Let } E_Y = 400 \\ I_X = 70 \% \text{ of } 400 = 280 \\ E_X = 60 \% \text{ of } 400 = 240 \\ S_X = 280 - 240 = 40 \\ \text{Now, } I_X \text{ is } 60 \% \text{ less than } I_Y \implies I_X = 40 \% \text{ of } I_Y \\ 280 = 0.4 \times I_Y \implies I_Y = 700 \\ S_Y = 700 - 400 = 300 \\ \text{Ratio } S_X : S_Y = 40 : 300 = 2 : 15 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ratios aur variables se step by step balance kar sakte ho par fractions me atakne ka risk hota hai.

Mathematically :-

$$ I_X = 0.4 I_Y \\ E_X = 0.6 E_Y \\ I_X = 0.7 E_Y \\ 0.4 I_Y = 0.7 E_Y \implies \frac{I_Y}{E_Y} = \frac{7}{4} \\ \text{Let } I_Y = 700k, E_Y = 400k \\ I_X = 0.7(400k) = 280k \\ E_X = 0.6(400k) = 240k \\ S_X = 40k \\ S_Y = 700k - 400k = 300k \\ \frac{S_X}{S_Y} = \frac{40k}{300k} = \frac{2}{15} $$

Exam Takeaway: Aise multiple ratio wale questions me linking variable ko pakda kar. Yahan $I_X$ dono conditions ko connect kar raha tha, wahi se calculation start karni thi.

questions.q: In an adult population of a city, 40\% men and 30\% women are married. What is the percentage of married adult population if no man marries more than one woman and no woman marries more than one man; and there are no widows and widowers?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, seedha logic hai CDS aur CGL ka. 'No man marries more than one woman' ka simply matlab hai Married Men = Married Women. Toh $M:F$ ka direct inverse ratio banega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Weightage formula mat lagana, seedha JSM laga. Base $30\%$ pakad le aur deviation total unit me baant de. Pen-free observation se 10 second me hack ho gaya!

Mathematically :-
$$ 40\\% M = 30\\% F \\implies M:F = 3:4 \\\\ Total = 7 \\ units \\\\ Base = 30\\% \\\\ Dev = \\frac{3 \\times (40-30)}{7} = \\frac{30}{7} = 4\\frac{2}{7}\\% \\\\ Ans = 30\\% + 4\\frac{2}{7}\\% = 34\\frac{2}{7}\\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Maan kar absolute count me equations laga aur phir percentage nikal.

Mathematically :-
$$ M = 300, F = 400 \\\\ Mar_M = 120, Mar_F = 120 \\\\ Total \\ Married = 240 \\\\ \\% = \\frac{240}{700} \\times 100 = 34\\frac{2}{7}\\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Inverse ratio hamesha percentage variables ko fraction me set karta hai aur aage ka kam deviation dekhta hai.

questions.q: The square root of a number is increased by $40\%$, and the result is 21. Find the original number. (CPO TIER I- \frac{12}{12}/2025-SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $40\%$ ka matlab $2/5$ hota hai. Yani base agar $5$ hai toh $2$ badhega. Seedha $7$ ka multiple check karna chahiye dimag me!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Root ko $40\%$ badhaya, yani $5$ unit se $7$ unit kar diya. Sawal cheekh cheekh ke keh raha hai ki naya root $21$ hai. Toh $7$ unit $= 21$, matlab $1$ unit $= 3$. Pucha kya hai? Original number! Pehle original root nikal, $5$ unit $= 15$. Ab is $15$ ka square phek ke maar, $225$ aayega. Pen uthane ki zaroorat hi nahi thi!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic se jana hai toh maan le original number $x$ hai. Uska root $\sqrt{x}$ hai. Equation banegi: $\sqrt{x} \times (1 + \frac{40}{100}) = 21$. Yani $\sqrt{x} \times \frac{7}{5} = 21$. Solve karega toh $\sqrt{x} = 15$ aayega, fir square karke $x = 225$ milega. Par isme time waste hota hai bhai.

Exam Takeaway: Exam me jaldi baazi me 'original number' ki jagah root $15$ mat tick kar dena, pucha kya hai uspe focus karo!

ParameterCalculation
A. Base Shift1. $5 \to 7$
B. Real Value2. $7 \text{ units} = 21 \implies 5 \text{ units} = 15$
